meta.name: parallel-feature-development
meta.description: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

copy.tagline: 把大型功能拆成小块，多团队同时开发互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要多人同时开发一个功能的不同部分
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel development of large features without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team develops different parts of a feature concurrently

howto.what: 拆分大功能时,Claude 会给出文件归属划分(按目录、模块或层)、避免冲突的规则、接口契约写法,以及纵向切片/横向分层等集成与分支策略。
howto.when: 当你要求把大功能拆成并行工作流、让多个 agent 同时实现同一系统的不同层,或需要划分文件归属以避免合并冲突时触发。

say.text: 把这个登录功能拆成几个并行工作流,并划分文件归属
say.note: 会给出目录、模块或层的归属方案

say.text: 两个 agent 要同时改同一个系统,接口契约怎么定?
say.note: 会说明契约文件与只读约定

say.text: 这个全栈功能用纵向切片还是横向分层?
say.note: 会对比两种集成方式的利弊

howto.what_en: Claude splits a large feature into parallel work streams: it assigns file ownership by directory, module, or layer, defines interface contracts, and picks integration patterns (vertical slice, horizontal layer, or hybrid).
howto.when_en: Use when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when multiple agents implement different layers of one system, or when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts.

say_en.text: Split this login feature into parallel work streams and assign owners.
say_en.note: Returns directory, module, or layer ownership plans

say_en.text: Two agents must edit the same system—how do we define an interface contract?
say_en.note: Shows contract files and read-only rules

say_en.text: Should this full-stack feature use a vertical slice or horizontal layer?
say_en.note: Compares the tradeoffs of each integration pattern
